title: A core charge change writes no price on an internal work order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved, with one part, part 1, that carries a core.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Change part 1's core charge to $30.00.
  3. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens; the core row shows with no price.

Step 2:

  • The core charge is saved.

Step 3:

  • Part 1 and its core row still show no sell price.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R19: “No event writes a sell price onto an internal or no-charge work order, or onto a no-charge line (Story 12): not receiving a special-order part at a real cost, not editing the cost on a vendor invoice, not a core-charge change (today each of these derives or rewrites the part's sell price from the cost). Cost is written normally. The receive screen replaces its notice "Updating the cost also updates the sell price" with "Internal work order: cost only, no sell price" (or "No Charge work order: cost only, no sell price", "No Charge line: cost only"); the vendor-invoice item edit, which has no such notice today, gains the same cost-only notice for items on internal and no-charge work orders and lines. A sell price appears only on Convert to Billable or Mark as Billable, derived from the cost on the line at that moment (S2-R6, S12-R5).”
  • S2-E7: “Parts with a core charge work as today up to resolution: the core row shows on the lines with no price, Core OK / Not OK is required before Close as it is before invoicing, and the completion wizard shows no core amount on an internal or no-charge work order. Not OK adds a charge to nobody; the vendor's core charge on the bill is cost and posts with the bill line (S7-R3). OK creates the vendor return as today, and its credit posts as in S7-R3a. Core cost is never part of Parts cost on the document or in the report. A stock part picked with its core posts both costs at Close, so the Close confirmation row says what posts: "Stock parts $[amount], includes $[core amount] core cost · Posted to [account]"; the document and the report keep Parts cost without cores.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
